content.short: Teleton is a Telegram video app where viewers and creators take part in streaming, engagement, and reward based SocialFi activity.
content.description: Teleton is a Telegram based video platform that combines streaming, creator participation, and token driven audience engagement. The product centers on a watch to earn model where users can interact with content through views, likes, comments, and referrals while creators build channels and share in platform activity. Its positioning is closer to a SocialFi media app than a standard wallet or DeFi tool, with the TON connection coming through rewards, community growth loops, and Telegram native access.
content.meta: Teleton brings streaming, creator participation, referrals, and reward based SocialFi activity to Telegram users in the TON ecosystem.
